title: cenchrus ciliaris f. intermedius
intro: Cenchrus ciliaris f. intermedius, commonly known as a type of grass, is a species of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Cenchrus ciliaris f. intermedius, including its flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions.
